description: This file defines extension methods for working with Task and ValueTask in C#, providing utilities such as suppressing exceptions, logging, timeouts, cancellation, and result handling to improve asynchronous programming practices within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: OrleansInternal.OrleansTaskExtentions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for Task and ValueTask to facilitate asynchronous operations with timeout, cancellation, logging, and exception suppression.

methods.name: SuppressThrowing
methods.description: Configures a task for suppression of exceptions during continuation.

methods.name: Ignore
methods.description: Wraps a ValueTask or Task to ignore its completion result, executing synchronously if already completed successfully.

methods.name: LogException
methods.description: Logs exceptions for failed tasks using a provided ILogger and error code.

methods.name: SafeExecute
methods.description: Executes an async action, capturing exceptions as task failures without propagating.

methods.name: ExecuteAndIgnoreException
methods.description: Executes an async action and absorbs any exceptions, preventing them from propagating.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the task, including ID and status.

methods.name: WaitWithThrow
methods.description: Waits for a task with a timeout, throwing TimeoutException if timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForResultWithThrow
methods.description: Waits for a Task<T> with a timeout and returns the result, throwing TimeoutException if timeout occurs.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: Applies a timeout to a task, throwing TimeoutException if time elapses before completion.

methods.name: WithCancellation
methods.description: Converts a task into a cancellable task using a CancellationToken, throwing TaskCanceledException on cancellation.

methods.name: WrapInTask
methods.description: Wraps an Action into a Task, returning a completed task or a faulted task if exception occurs.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Synchronously obtains the result of a Task<T> using GetAwaiter().GetResult().

methods.name: WhenCancelled
methods.description: Returns a task that completes when the provided CancellationToken is canceled.
